summary: 柏林格莱斯德莱克的废弃铁路用地在城市重整中变成大型公园。设计者在休闲、生态与铁路遗产之间协调，利用草地、小径、旧有铺面和社区花园，保留了部分场地记忆。
logic: 闲置后重新成为市区焦点
规划公园引发不同诉求
清理场地并组织开放空间

sentences: Just over a kilometer south of Berlin’s Potsdamer Platz, near the left bank of the Landwehr Canal, an extensive, triangular-shaped area of waste ground once separated the neighbourhoods of Kreuzberg to the east and Schöneberg to the west.
在柏林波茨达默普拉茨以南一公里处，位于兰德韦赫尔运河左岸附近，一个广阔、三角形的废墟区，一度将东边的克鲁兹贝格居民区和西边的施内贝格居民区隔开。
Known as Gleisdreieck, meaning ‘triangle of rails’, it was formed by the intersection of different railway lines built in the mid-nineteenth century that entered Berlin from the south.
它被称为Gleisdreieck，意思是“三轨铁路”，由十九世纪中叶从南方进入柏林的不同铁路交汇而成。

Tracks, sheds and warehouses belonging to three old railway stations – Dresdner Bahnhof (1875-1882), Potsdamer Bahnhof (1838-1944) and Anhalter Bahnhof (1839- 1952) – are situated on a raised area some twenty hectares in size, at a height of four metres above the surrounding ground level.
三个老火车站的铁轨、棚子和仓库(德累斯特纳·巴赫诺夫(1875-1882年)、波茨达默·巴赫尼霍夫(1838-1944年)和安哈尔特·巴赫努夫(1839-1952年))面积约20公顷，比周围地面高4米。
As the railway infrastructure gradually ceased to be used, the whole area of Gleisdreieck became increasingly run down and abandoned, to the point of being used as a rubbish tip after 1945.
随着铁路基础设施逐渐停止使用，Gleisdreieck的整个地区越来越被摧毁和遗弃，1945年以后被用作垃圾。
Meanwhile, vegetation took over, turning it into a surprising, natural haven in the middle of built-up areas.
同时，植被被接管，变成一个令人惊讶的自然避难所在建筑地区中间。
The closeness of the wall which divided the city of Berlin between 1961 and 1990 also contributed to the fact that Gleisdreieck was for decades clearly identified as no-man’s-land.
1961年至1990年分隔柏林市的隔离墙的近距离也促成了这一事实，即几十年来，格列斯德雷耶克被明确定为无人之地。
Only a station of the same name in Berlin’s underground railway system testified to its existence.
柏林地下铁路系统只有一个同名站站，证明了它的存在。
Shortly before the fall of the Berlin Wall, however, the German Museum of Technology was established there, attracting large numbers of visitors and giving visibility to the site.
然而，在柏林墙倒塌前不久，德国技术博物馆就在那里建立起来，吸引了大批参观者，并让该场址可见一斑。
More importantly, the unification of the formerly divided city gave the zone more centrality, at which point it became imperative to identify a purpose for it.
更重要的是，统一以前分裂的城市使该区更加居于中心地位，此时必须确定该区的目的。
After 2006, the State of Berlin put forward the proposal of converting Gleisdreieck into a large urban park that would integrate the different urban zones which converged there.
2006年之后，柏林州提出了将Gleisdreieck变成一个大型城市公园的建议，该公园将汇集在那里的不同城市地区融为一体。
The decades-long isolation of the site, which had formerly presented a problem, now represented an opportunity for joining the southern area of Potsdamer Platz with Kreuzberg and Schöneberg.
几十年来，该场址一直被隔离，以前曾造成问题，现在，该场址成为与Kreuzberg和Schöneberg一起进入波茨达默普拉茨南部地区的一个机会。
The creation of the park would trigger one of the biggest urban expansions inside Berlin, all within a framework of multiple uses and social characteristics.
公园的建立将引发柏林内部最大的城市扩张之一，所有这些都是在多种用途和社会特点的框架内进行的。

It was necessary to stimulate the development of sixteen new hectares of local amenities that would be capable of integrating different generations and social groups in a sustainable way, and in harmony with nature.
有必要刺激16公顷新的地方设施的发展，这些设施将能够以可持续的方式并与自然和谐地融合不同的世代和社会群体。
Following intense discussion with local proprietors and residents, the need to reconcile these goals with the conservation of railway heritage also emerged.
在与当地业主和居民进行深入讨论之后，还出现了协调这些目标与保护铁路遗产的必要性。
Once the area had been subjected to a process of undergrowth clearance and decontamination, it was then organized around a combination of existing and added elements.
该地区一旦受到生长不足的清除和净化过程的影响，就围绕现有和新增要素进行组织。
The project as a whole was planned around a large central meadow, intersected from east to west by a concrete footpath, and from north to south by a pair of railway lines.
整个项目是围绕一个大中央草原规划的，东向西以混凝土通道交错，北向南以两条铁路线交错。
Once a month, a train slowly travels along these lines from its parking shed to the German Museum of Technology.
每月一次，一列火车缓慢地沿着这些路线从停放库前往德国技术博物馆。

The concrete footpath, which is a continuation of one of the main Kreuzberg boulevards, starts in the east, bridges the four-metre difference in ground level by means of a stairway, and suddenly ends in the west on reaching the underground lines.
混凝土行进道是Kreuzberg主要大道之一的延续，从东面开始，通过楼梯连接地面四米的差别，然后突然在西部到达地下线。

paragraphs.brief: 改造完成后的特色与设施。
sentences: North of the meadow, there is a large concrete slab with rounded edges.
草原北面有一块大块水泥板，有四面边缘。
Being south-facing, this functions as a big sunny terrace, full of benches complete with footrests.
以南面的景象，它发挥出一个阳光灿烂的大阳台的作用，充满长凳，充满了脚印。
In the south, the meadow overlooks Yorckstrasse, an underpass crossed by more than fifteen former railway bridges.
在南部，草地忽略了Yorckstrasse，这是一座地下通道，有15多座前铁路桥经过。
To the east of the meadow there is quite a dense forest of pre-existing maples, oaks and birches, as well as newly planted trees of the same species.
在草原以东，有相当稠密的森林，包括原有的地图、橡树和树枝，以及新种植的同一物种的树木。
In this area, a couple of large metal frames each hold two swings.
在这个区域，一对大金属架每人有两下摇摆。

The edges of the park are finished with a collection of distinctive, functional spaces, for example a nursery, sports fields, concave surfaces for skateboards, stages for dancing, community gardens, or simply areas covered in gravel obtained from the site itself.
在公园边缘，有一系列独特的功能性空间，例如苗圃、运动场、滑板雕像表面、舞蹈舞台、社区花园，或从园区本身得到的砂砾覆盖的简单区域。

paragraphs.brief: 对已完成项目的积极评价。
sentences: Although initially the regeneration of Gleisdreieck Park was the subject of disagreement between those who were in favour of safeguarding the railway heritage and those who wanted to regenerate the adjacent neighbourhoods, it was opened to the public in September 2011.
虽然最初，Gleisdreieck公园的复兴是赞成保护铁路遗产的人与希望重建邻近住区的人之间分歧的主题，但该公园于2011年9月向公众开放。
The heart of Berlin now has a new green lung, in which the atmosphere of various small, very different corners fits neatly into a large-scale, wide-ranging and robust general order.
柏林的心脏现在有一个新的绿色肺，不同小角落的大气完全适应了大规模、广泛和强大的总体秩序。
This has been possible precisely because the intervention was not limited to conserving industrial remains in order to promote railway history.
之所以能够做到这一点，正是因为干预并不限于保护工业遗迹，以促进铁路历史。
And as a reminder of the six decades of human absence, during which nature took over, the park has been able to conserve to some extent the spirit of the non-place that preceded it.
作为人类消失60年的提醒大自然接管了这60年公园在某种程度上保持了前方非地方的精神

items.en: Which TWO reasons are given for the choice of Gleisdreieck as a site for a park?
items.zh: 选择Gleisdreieck作为公园的场地有两个原因？
correct: It contained a particular tourist attraction.
It lay at the heart of the reunited city.
它位于统一城市的中心。

items.en: The list below identifies some of the possible aims of urban redevelopment projects. Which TWO things did the State of Berlin hope to achieve with the Gleisdreieck development?

correct: to bring people of different ages together
让不同年龄的人聚在一起

items.why: 摘要首句“在新公园中央有一片…”与原文“large central meadow”一一对应。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: to bring people of different ages together
题干说让不同年龄的人聚在一起，原文用 integrate 和 generations 表达代际融合。
footpath 就是给行人走的小道。concrete 补充了路面的材料。
points: 柏林希望把久被隔绝的地块改造为公园，同时带动周边街区整合与发展。

clauses: More importantly, the unification of the formerly divided city gave the zone more centrality, ….
“at which point it became imperative to identify a purpose for it”修饰前面的 centrality。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 which 时，回看 centrality，再把修饰信息接回主句。
…, it was then organized around a combination of existing and added elements.
连接词 once 引出“Once the area had been subjected to a process of undergrowth clearance and decontamination”，说明主句的时间关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 once 把这一层关系补进去。
